chapter.title: Time to Decide
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 at flowchart-node level from the PowerPyx 100% chart (10 nodes and the phase label [ EXPLORE JERICHO ]) and the game’s text (the detroitbecometext template resolved against the string table). INSIDE JERICHO (checkpoint) → [ EXPLORE JERICHO: TALK TO DYING ANDROID, TALK TO JOSH, TALK TO NORTH, TALK TO DAMAGED ANDROID, LET THERE BE LIGHT, all optional ] → TALK TO LUCY and CHECK EMPTY CRATE (both required, in parallel) → TALK TO SIMON → MARKUS HATCHED A PLAN, the only ending. Three prompts off the chart: the arrival (TRAIL / ANDROID / JERICHO / REFUGE / FREE?, then LOST / SOMBER / LUCID / DIRECT) and North’s topics (TIME HERE? / WOUNDED / JERICHO / YOU / SPARE PARTS). Arrows, all small: Josh +1 for talking to him; North +1 for talking to her, −1 for YOU, +1 at the Simon scene; Simon +1 at the Simon scene. No Jericho arrow (the wiki lists one at the Simon scene; the template does not). No probability, timer, public-opinion or instability change. Researched in docs/research/ch16-time-to-decide.md.

decisions.title: Inside Jericho (checkpoint)
decisions.context: Markus has found Jericho, the hold of an old ship where fugitive androids hide; he is wounded in the abdomen. “Who are you?” Josh: “Fugitives… just like you... My name is Josh.” Simon: “I’m Simon.” North: “North.”

options.label: Scripted, no choice
options.effect: The start node and checkpoint (05:13 PM, November 6th).

decisions.note: Chart node INSIDE JERICHO (checkpoint). The wiki and PowerPyx commenters report a bug that can leave it locked.

benchmark.note: A narrated event quoting the template; one fact to Markus’s knowledge; no stat change.

decisions.title: Who they are (not a chart node)

options.label: TRAIL
options.effect: “And you knew that only an android could follow the trail, didn’t you?” Josh and Simon on the signs and the key. The Phileas page mentions a flashback (not in the template).

options.label: ANDROID
options.effect: “How many are you?” North: “There are nineteen of us still in working order...”

options.label: JERICHO
options.effect: “This is Jericho?” Josh: “It’s a refuge for those who don’t want to be slaves anymore...”

options.label: REFUGE
options.effect: “I thought Jericho was a place where androids lived in freedom...” Josh: “We do live in freedom…”

options.label: FREE?
options.effect: “And hiding just to stay alive… That’s freedom to you?” Josh and North: hiding is the only way to survive.

benchmark.note: A decision with the five buttons in the game’s order; lines only.

decisions.title: More freedom than you ever did (not a chart node)
decisions.context: Josh: “I understand how you feel... but we have more freedom here than you ever did.”

options.label: LOST
options.effect: “I came to Jericho looking for hope... Looks like I’m not gonna find any here…”

options.label: SOMBER
options.effect: “Maybe I was never really free... And now I need to decide who I really am...”

options.label: LUCID
options.effect: “You’re no freer than you ever were… You’ve only found a new master.”

options.label: DIRECT
options.effect: “Waiting in the dark for something to happen? That’s not how I see freedom.”

decisions.note: No arrow (template). Every branch closes with Simon (“You’re lost…”), Josh (“You’re safe here.”) and North: “Go and see Lucy. She may be able to help you.”

benchmark.note: A decision with the four buttons in the game’s order; lines only. North’s pointer to Lucy becomes a fact.

decisions.title: Talk to Dying Android
decisions.context: A female android by a fire: “Do you know what happens after death?… I was glad to meet you, Markus.” She shuts down.

options.label: Talk to her
options.effect: She shuts down after the talk (wiki: Deceased).

options.label: Walk on
options.effect: Nothing.

decisions.gate: Optional, in the [ EXPLORE JERICHO ] bracket.
decisions.note: Chart node TALK TO DYING ANDROID; the template’s “Talk with damaged android (near fire)”. No stat change.

benchmark.note: An option in the repeatable hold scene; a fact to Markus’s knowledge.

decisions.title: Talk to Josh
decisions.context: Josh watches over a boy android thrown out by his owners: “To help them we need blue blood and biocomponents… We’re slowly dying out…”

options.label: Talk to him
options.effect: Josh +1 (small; template {REL Josh SmallUp}; wiki “Talking to him”).

options.label: Walk on
options.effect: Nothing.

decisions.note: Chart node TALK TO JOSH. The only Josh arrow in the chapter.

benchmark.note: Hold option 1, effect joshTrust +1; a fact on the shortage.

decisions.title: Talk to North
decisions.context: North sits on a box bouncing a ball against a wall.

options.label: Talk to her
options.effect: North +1 (small; template {REL North SmallUp} at the start; wiki “Talking to her”), then her topics.

options.label: Walk on
options.effect: Nothing.

benchmark.note: Hold option 2, effect northTrust +1; cuts in her topic scene.

decisions.title: North’s topics (not a chart node)
decisions.context: The template’s prompt in “Talk with North”; her closing line: “If you came here for comfort, you came to the wrong place.”

options.label: TIME HERE?
options.effect: “4 weeks, 3 days, 11 hours.”

options.label: WOUNDED
options.effect: “That’s how the humans treat those who disobey…”

options.label: JERICHO
options.effect: “Nobody knows anymore…”

options.label: YOU
options.effect: “What do you care?” North −1 (small; template {REL North SmallDown}; wiki “Picking “you” while talking to her”).

options.label: SPARE PARTS
options.effect: “Can’t just go shopping at a CyberLife store.”

decisions.note: One topic per talk (template: one choice group, one closing line; not confirmed in game). The Relationship_Stat page’s “Rises to “Neutral” if asked North about “You”” does not fit the template’s icons at face value; open question for the operator.

benchmark.note: A decision cut in from the hold, then back. YOU applies northTrust −1, so the talk nets 0.

decisions.title: Talk to Damaged Android
decisions.context: An android sitting on the floor: “They tied me to the back of a car... I don’t wanna shut down...”

options.label: Talk to him
options.effect: Nothing changes (wiki status: Alive).

options.label: Walk on
options.effect: Nothing.

decisions.note: Chart node TALK TO DAMAGED ANDROID; the template’s “Talk with damaged android (sitting)”.

decisions.title: Let There Be Light
decisions.context: Light the four oil drums in the hold; androids gather around them.

options.label: Light the drums
options.effect: Nothing changes.

options.label: Leave them
options.effect: Nothing.

decisions.note: Chart node LET THERE BE LIGHT. No dialogue in the template.

benchmark.note: Hold option 4; changes the hold’s description.

decisions.title: Talk to Lucy
decisions.context: Behind a white plastic sheet; she treats Markus’s wound and gives him blue blood: “A part of shadow and a part of light... Which will prevail? Your choices will shape our destiny.”

options.label: Scripted, required
options.effect: Markus is healed. Two lines are cut in the template and not built.

decisions.gate: Required (the main objective), one fork of the bracket’s exit.
decisions.note: Chart node TALK TO LUCY. No stat change.

benchmark.note: Hold option 5; required before Simon; a fact with her prophecy. Order with the crate is free.

decisions.title: Check Empty Crate
decisions.context: An empty crate by the wall shows where parts come from: the CyberLife warehouses in Detroit Harbor.

options.label: Scripted, required
options.effect: Markus has the idea of the raid; completes “Explore Jericho”.

decisions.gate: Required, the other fork of the exit.
decisions.note: Chart node CHECK EMPTY CRATE. No dialogue in the template; the wiki: “Obtains a location for parts”.

benchmark.note: Hold option 6; required before Simon; a fact naming the warehouses.

decisions.title: Talk to Simon
decisions.context: Markus proposes stealing parts from the CyberLife warehouses “without fighting”; Simon and Josh object, North agrees (“I’m with you.”), then Simon and Josh.

options.label: Scripted, no choice
options.effect: North +1, Simon +1 and, from story 1.9.8, Jericho +1 (small; template {REL North SmallUp} {REL Simon SmallUp}, wiki “Talking to Simon” for Jericho, confirmed by the readout NORTH ▲, JERICHO ▲, SIMON ▲ in video frame y50ZjZWX0gU 11:45).

decisions.gate: After TALK TO LUCY and CHECK EMPTY CRATE.
decisions.note: Chart node TALK TO SIMON. A fixed exchange; the raid cannot be declined.

benchmark.note: Hold option 7 (needs Lucy and the crate), then the ending event, which applies both arrows. Story 1.9.8: the Jericho arrow the template omits is applied; it is scene data, so older snapshots keep two arrows.

decisions.title: Markus Hatched a Plan (ending)
decisions.context: The only ending: North, Simon and Josh agree to raid the CyberLife warehouses at the docks.

options.label: Always
options.effect: `ch16Outcome` = Markus hatched a plan; the raid is Spare Parts.

decisions.note: Chart ending MARKUS HATCHED A PLAN, no icon. “This chapter has only one outcome.”

benchmark.note: Event scene recording the outcome; the plan becomes a fact.
